text:
amira: FYI planning a maintenance rotation to refresh GPU drivers + NIC firmware across select racks in us-west2 and eu-west1 next Tue. Goal: < 1% impact to hostable SLA traffic.

kai: can you share the exact roll sequence and per-rack window? also need to know backfill source and admission controls.

amira: sequence: zone-by-zone, 1 rack canary per AZ, 20m soak, then ramp. Per rack target 12-18m drain + 5-10m reprovision. Entire region window ~5h including backfill slack. Backfill from reserved spare pool first, then short preemptible bursts limited to non-guaranteed customers.

raj: critical: reserved/dedicated capacity must be preserved. We'll only evict shared-tenant pods. If autoscaler would steal reserved nodes we block it during the window.

marc: request: avoid EU business hours. propose eu-west1 maintenance 02:30-07:30 UTC, us-west2 10:00-15:00 UTC. Also share calendar invites for oncall and infra leads.

ine: need automated detection: if p95 latency > 2x baseline for 15m or error-rate increase > 0.5% open incident automatically. Also surface a console banner + scheduled email to enterprise accounts at T-48h and T-1h.

sre-bot: Maintenance ticket created: id=mt-2026-11-17-gpu-nic-rotate. eu-west1 window 2026-11-17 02:30-07:30 UTC, us-west2 window 2026-11-17 10:00-15:00 UTC. Notifications: #incidents @ 48h, 1h.

kai: what are the degrade policies if backfill fails? Do we throttle or fall back to smaller variants?

amira: degrade plan (ordered): 1) pause non-SLA batch jobs via job-adm; 2) enable model routing to smaller quantized variants for latency critical routes (flag: --route-fallback=quantized); 3) open short queue mode (max wait 30s) for best-effort traffic. We'll not route Dedicated tenants to preemptible nodes.

raj: cost estimate: preemptible burst + additional egress = approx $9k regional for the window. Recommend finance hold a contingency of $10k. I'll flag on the budget channel.

marc: who owns the rollout and rollback? need a single-point owner per region and a short abort checklist.

amira: owners: amira (eu-west1 lead), kai (us-west2 lead). Abort checklist snippet: ```# verify status
infractl pool list --region eu-west1
infractl drain status rack-07 --region eu-west1
# abort/backout
infractl pool rollback --pool pool-gpu-shared --to-snapshot pre-maint
# stop backfill
infractl pool backfill cancel --pool pool-gpu-shared
```

ine: add the canary policy: first rack in each zone is canary, wait 30m, check p50/p95/p99, error-rate, infra metrics (mem/gpu-temp/thermal). If any metric crosses threshold revert that rack and escalate.

sre-bot: Canary scheduled: eu-west1-zone-b rack-3 at 2026-11-17 02:40 UTC. Health checks will run every 5m during canary.

kai: i'll prepare traffic-shift playbook and update SDK docs for the routing flag. Also will create a small test harness to validate quantized variant quality for baseline prompts.

raj: approved contingency up to $10k. put the approval on record in #finance-ops. If actuals look higher, we pause preemptible bursts.

amira: final ops asks: 1) post announcement in #announcements T-48h, 2) email enterprise contacts T-48h and T-1h, 3) put a console banner T-2h and remove T+1h, 4) run a smoke test suite against each region after completion. I'll draft the comms message and drop it here. :thumbsup:

marc: thanks. i'll create the calendar and add infra oncall, svc-owners, and SRE leads.

ine: add validation steps to the runbook: smoke traffic for 15m, run model-quality checks on 30 golden prompts, validate token costs.

amira: noted. i'll push runbook updates and the post-maint POA. if anything abnormal happens we'll produce a postmortem template and share with impacted customers.

sre-bot: Reminder scheduled: maintenance notice to #incidents at 2026-11-15 02:30 UTC (48h).
